description: This file contains helper functions for the Coverage API router, including retrieving route callables, converting signatures and dataclasses to pydantic models, creating combined models, and mapping route schemas. It is used for dynamic API route handling and validation.

methods.name: Callable get_route_callable(app: "BaseApp", route: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the callable (function or method) associated with a specific route within the application.

methods.name: Dict[str,Tuple[Any,Field]] signature_to_fields(app: "BaseApp", route: str)
methods.description: Converts a function's signature into a dictionary of pydantic fields for validation and serialization.

methods.name: Dict[str,Tuple[Any,Field]] dataclass_to_fields(model_name: str)
methods.description: Transforms a dataclass into a dictionary of pydantic fields, extracting annotations, descriptions, and titles.

methods.name: Type[BaseModel] create_combined_model( model_name: str, *field_sets: Dict[str, Tuple[Any, Field]], filter_by_provider: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Generates a combined pydantic model by merging multiple field sets, optionally filtering by provider.

methods.name: Dict[str,Dict[str,Any]] get_route_schema_map( app: "BaseApp", command_model_map: Dict[str, str], filter_by_provider: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Creates a mapping of routes to their input/output schemas and callable references, facilitating dynamic schema generation.

ctags.name: create_combined_model
ctags.signature: ( model_name: str, *field_sets: Dict[str, Tuple[Any, Field]], filter_by_provider: Optional[str] = None, )

ctags.name: dataclass_to_fields
ctags.pattern: /^def dataclass_to_fields(model_name: str) -> Dict[str, Tuple[Any, Field]]:  # type: ignore$/

ctags.name: get_route_schema_map
ctags.signature: ( app: "BaseApp", command_model_map: Dict[str, str], filter_by_provider: Optional[str] = None, )

ctags.name: signature_to_fields
ctags.pattern: /^def signature_to_fields(app: "BaseApp", route: str) -> Dict[str, Tuple[Any, Field]]:  # type: ig/
